meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用 aeon 1.x 写 Python 代码处理时间序列任务:加载数据、训练模型、输出结果,覆盖分类、预测、异常检测等场景。需要 Python 3.10+ 与 aeon 包。
howto.when: 当你说要处理时间序列数据(带时间戳、有前后顺序的观察值),并需要分类、预测、异常检测等专用算法时触发。

say.text: 预测这份序列未来 5 步的数值,用 NaiveForecaster。
say.note: Claude 会运行预测器并输出预测数值。

say.text: 对这段序列做异常检测,标出分数最高的异常点。
say.note: Claude 会运行 STOMP 等检测器,给出异常位置。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the aeon 1.x toolkit to write Python code for time series ML: load data, train models, output results, covering classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, etc. Requires Python 3.10+ and the aeon package.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions time-indexed observations, sequential patterns, or temporal data and asks for classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, or specialized algorithms.

say_en.text: Classify this time series with aeon RocketClassifier and print accuracy.
say_en.note: Claude writes a script to train and output the score.

say_en.text: Forecast the next 5 values of this series with aeon NaiveForecaster.
say_en.note: Claude runs the forecaster and prints predicted values.

say_en.text: Find anomalies in this sequence and mark the top-scoring points.
say_en.note: Runs STOMP; returns anomaly locations or scores.
